provenance: Reconstruction authorized by the author; original paper implementation/configuration is unavailable.

paper_specified.sampling: group-aware outermost layer only; inner layers unchanged
paper_specified.time_metric: arithmetic mean of 20 complete training epoch wall times

reconstruction_choices.note: These explicit engineering choices are not claimed to be historical paper settings. Revise protocol ID if changed.
reconstruction_choices.fanout_order: forward/model-layer order; sampling expands in reverse [5,5,10]
reconstruction_choices.gpu_cache_unit_reason: Interpret 4 GB as 4096 MiB to match the existing GIDS API; PDF does not define GB versus GiB.
reconstruction_choices.io_geometry_reason: PA has 128 float32 values per row, so g2 has only 1024 useful bytes. Retain g2 and pad to existing 4 KiB I/O alignment; do not substitute g8. This geometry may change performance relative to the original implementation.
reconstruction_choices.graph_policy: directed OGB source, remove self loops then append one per node; same graph for both arms; inherited engineering choice, PDF normalization unspecified
reconstruction_choices.optimizer_basis: Inherited current implementation, not recovered from the paper; no accuracy matching by post-hoc selection.
reconstruction_choices.run_order: seed-major; repeat0 GIDS then DiGiT, repeat1 DiGiT then GIDS; fresh process for every run
reconstruction_choices.train_split: official OGB time split; all 1207179 IDs once per epoch, keep final partial batch
reconstruction_choices.cpu_cache_rounding: floor(floor(111059956*0.1)/8)*8; common whole-page budget, three fewer rows than integer 10 percent budget
reconstruction_choices.gids_cpu_selection: existing RevPR page-adapted static cache, explicitly disclosed adaptation, not unmodified upstream GIDS
reconstruction_choices.digit_cpu_selection: one seed0 dry-run epoch at target fanouts/group size/order on no-hot bootstrap; count unique logical feature inputs per batch; descending frequency then node ID; freeze hot set and rebuild once
reconstruction_choices.gids_train_order: PCG64(SeedSequence([seed,epoch])) permutation of official training IDs
reconstruction_choices.digit_train_order: PCG64(SeedSequence([seed,epoch])) permutation of official training IDs
reconstruction_choices.evaluation: common uniform logical [10,5,5] traces, seed0, full official validation each epoch and full test after epoch20; save/restore training RNG; final epoch checkpoint, no early stopping
reconstruction_choices.cache_lifetime: persistent across training and validation for all20 epochs; no cold-state reset or dropped warmup epoch
reconstruction_choices.timing: device-synchronized epoch boundaries; include root-order/dataloader and lazy first-batch initialization; exclude validation/test/setup/preprocessing from mean training epoch; report those separately
reconstruction_choices.accuracy_reporting: report each seed/repeat final-test accuracy and all paired differences; average repeats within seed; never force paper point values
reconstruction_choices.preprocessing_implementation: Candidate implementation captured in snapshot; full g2 build and semantic equivalence still need verification.
reconstruction_choices.grouping_owner_order: descending normalized original degree, tie ascending node ID; exclude hot nodes from group candidates
reconstruction_choices.replica_priority: same fixed degree/ID order; eligible primary-owned, non-hot, uncovered neighbors; PCG64(0) state continues from primary pass
reconstruction_choices.graph_eids: retain existing normalized OGB EIDs; original CSC and graph construction validated against current source contract

paper_reference_only.use: comparison labels only, never inputs to measured metrics
